name: Add Array
description: This keyword is used to add a value to the entire series /array of the selected instrument. This keyword is used under the position keyword
how_to_use_markdown:
This keyword is used to add a value to the entire series /array of the selected instrument. This keyword is used under the position keyword

![Example](./images/img-1632142896.png)

The above example will add 10 to all the close values of the NIFTY 50 series

This keyword can be used under other indicators too, check the example below

![Example](./images/img-1632143080.png)
